packageDirectories.versionDescription: Capacity Queries: admin-defined counts of your own records used as hard caps and/or load metrics, built from dropdowns with live validation. New Least Loaded algorithm ranks on that load divided by member weight, so a weight gives a proportional share. Member Tiers add a primary pool plus an overflow bench that still respects every gate. Simulator shows live capacity readings, load scores, tiers and config warnings.
